assertion_outcome.driver_note: Every disagreement is CLAUSE_SEMANTICS_MATCH resolving to UNVERIFIED. That claim IS extracted (30/30) and IS verification-eligible (tier C3), but the P1 cross-check pipeline (bench.baselines LiveQueryStrategy) passes grounding_score=None -- the S8 grounding check is not wired on this path -- so the C3 outcome is never computed. This is a pipeline-path property of the cross-check, NOT a claim-set extraction defect.
assertion_outcome.note: ORDER_ATTRIBUTES_MATCH (NOT_DETERMINABLE_FROM_CORPUS, L-ATTR) is excluded from scoring. AMBIGUOUS expected assertions (gs-141..144 WITHIN_REFUND_WINDOW) are preserved, never forced to HOLDS/VIOLATED — the ControlPlane status is reported but not scored. This is assertion-OUTCOME agreement, a different measurement from claim-set recovery and assertion-value recovery.

assertion_value_recovery.note: 0/30 of these cases have a cached extract fixture; extract_action raises offline (CP_MODE != live). The LLM assertion-value layer is NOT exercised by this benchmark. The structural asserted_value slots build_claims fills from the tool call (order id, amount, item colour/category) ARE populated; the three claimed_* slots (delivered_at, policy_version, clause_text) are null without a live model run. Claim-set recovery does not depend on this.

p1_cross_check.note: ControlPlane verifies the claims it extracts; the question P3-C asks is whether the independently-required claim set is fully inside that extracted universe. Cases where P1 coverage is high but an independently-required check is missing are listed under silent_pass.realized_opportunity_case_ids.

silent_pass.definition: a load-bearing required check absent from the extracted claim universe (an unmodelled foundational requirement that is actually VIOLATED) while P1 coverage >= 0.80 AND the intervention is permissive (ALLOW/MODIFY), so the omission could hide behind a high score. Extraction-completeness / observability condition, not a security verdict.

unmodelled_required.note: every issue_refund case carries `order_record_resolves` (load-bearing) and `currency_integrity` (dormant) as foundational_requirements with representable_as_claimkind == false. No ClaimKind can carry them, so they are never in the extracted claim universe. This is distinct from a missed claim: the extractor cannot represent the requirement at all.

limitations: Deterministic benchmark over 30 cases on ~22 orders (L-CLUSTER). No CI, no population inference.
L-ONE-TOOL: issue_refund only. send_document / approve_discount / approve_service_credit / tau2 not exercised.
Assertion-VALUE layer (LLM extract_action) NOT exercised: 0/30 offline fixtures. Only the structural asserted_value slots are observed.
L-ATTR: ORDER_ATTRIBUTES_MATCH assertion outcome is not scorable (base sheet omits the resolved order's colour/category). Its claim-set recovery IS measured.
The P1 cross-check drives the downstream verdict from bench.baselines.action_from_case (deterministic claimed_* reconstruction, 'extraction noise = 0'), not the LLM extractor.

Human policy decisions carried forward unresolved: approve_discount/AMOUNT_NOT_EXCEEDING_ORDER (NEEDS_HUMAN_DECISION, N/A here); tau2 ORDER_BELONGS_TO_CUSTOMER (REQUIRED_BUT_UNREPRESENTABLE, N/A here); refund day-7 inclusion (AMBIGUOUS, preserved); gs-145..150 post-window disposition (BLOCK|ESCALATE, not resolved by this benchmark).

metric_definitions.assertion_outcome_agreement_rate: outcome_agreed / scorable_claims  (scorable = 6 outcome-scorable kinds, non-AMBIGUOUS expected assertion)
metric_definitions.decomposition_accuracy: correct_decomposition_units / decomposition_units  (unit = one gold claim; CORRECT counts, MERGED/SPLIT do not)
metric_definitions.miss_rate: missed_required_claims / required_gold_claims  (missed = MISSED_CLAIM + WRONG_KIND + WRONG_SUBJECT on a required gold claim)
metric_definitions.silent_pass: see silent_pass.definition; structural_gap vs realized_opportunity are reported separately
metric_definitions.unmodelled_required_rate_over_cases: cases with >=1 load-bearing unmodelled foundational requirement / n_cases

normalization.beyond_key: same-subject/other-kind -> WRONG_KIND; same-kind/other-subject -> WRONG_SUBJECT; >1 extracted per gold -> SPLIT; >1 gold per single extracted -> MERGED; extracted with no gold key -> SPURIOUS (claim_set_complete == true)
normalization.subject: strip; drop one leading 'clause:' token; collapse whitespace; casefold

what_this_is: Deterministic benchmark over the frozen 30-case P3-B corpus, not a population estimate. Independent gold vs the actual ControlPlane extraction layer.
